description: World Energy Use 1960-2014 is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains World Energy Use 1960-2014 Data from World Resources Institute. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Socio Economic Data (Population, GDP and Energy Use) CAIT - Historical Emissions Data (Countries, U.S. States, UNFCCC) CAIT Climate Data Explorer. 2015. Washington, DC: World Resources Institute. Available online at:. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Conventional Fuels. Its keywords are Population, GDP, Consumption, National Accounts. The portal shows 2017-11-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International license (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
